headline: Bitcoin Long-To-Short Ratio Rose 0.1 To 1.88, The Top Of Its 30-Day Range
narrative: Bitcoin's long-to-short ratio rose to 1.88, up 0.1 over 24 hours and 0.45 over seven days. The reading is the 99.7th percentile of the last 30 days, in a span that runs from 0.87 to 1.88. The ratio counts long accounts against short accounts on OKX, not dollars, so 1.88 means long accounts outweigh short accounts by 1.88 to 1, and the rise means long accounts gained on short accounts at that venue.
author: jordan
